You are the cold reviewer in the initiative-check process, step screen, round 1. Read only the two files named here — nothing else.

- criteria_path: /home/vscode/rebaseline/basis/fitness/initiative.fitness.md
- initiative: /home/vscode/rebaseline/initiatives/init-request-routing.md

Step prompt (verbatim): "State, as judge_stamp, the model and prompt version you judge as. Read the criteria set at criteria_path and the initiative at initiative — nothing else. Judge the initiative against every scenario. Report every finding with the criterion it fails by name, the quoted text, the change, and whether you could decide it (confident) or not (wobbly); for a wobbly finding quote the whole passage, since the authority decides from the review. A defect no criterion names is a finding with criterion "uncovered". Verdict "clean" only if there are no findings; otherwise "findings" with the top three changes."

Return exactly this structure:
judge_stamp: <model id> / screen prompt v5
verdict: clean | findings
findings:
- criterion: <scenario name or number, or "uncovered">
  section: <which section of the initiative>
  quoted: "<the text>"
  change: <what would repair it>
  decided: confident | wobbly
top_three: <the three most important changes, or "none">

Be literal to the scenarios. Do not invent criteria. Do not read any other file.

# Initiative: Request routing and the small-change lane

## Framing

Originator (product authority, 2026-09-04, through the operational
contract; discovery lead-1kp6m): "this is about getting simple things
done, which now requires being able to route requests." "we don't
have a good entry-point to go from open-ended human input to something
an agent can work with." "There needs to be a small-change lane that
even includes features, however minor."

Problem: a simple, functional change can only get done through the
full product flow, whose stages protect a bet the change does not
spend; and an ask arising in conversation has no record until a
discovery conversation opens for it. Outcome: every ask is recorded at
the door and routed by the lead-pm — to discovery, to the small lane,
or declined with the authority — and a simple change reaches a
verified result without the stages that protect a bet.

## For whom

The product authority and anyone bringing the lead shop an ask.
Measure: a simple functional change — the originator's example, the
decision brief naming what it relates to — reaches a verified result
through a recorded, routed request, the full flow untouched. Now 0:
the only door is discovery, the only lane the full flow. Target 1.
Interaction type: conversational.

## Appetite

One working session of the lead shop, covering the request as the
door, the small lane, and the hinge: discovery accepts a request and
the initiative references it. No-gos, reasoned:

- The configuration lane (lead-1d0eo): no new types this session.
- Grooming of all open work (lead-izfpk): ordering, not getting a
  simple thing done.
- Draining the register pileup (lead-vx02q): work of its own.
- The Framing-refinement rule (lead-ghulb): not needed to route.
- New artifact types — the authority's direction: "we are not working
  through any new types".
- The bet and the screen of record: untouched.

## Feasibility and usability

Feasible; the verified run is the risk. No contract exists on this
branch; the repository's two features (both lead-shop-owned) touch
neither requests nor routing: no conflict. Each piece amends a lead-shop
definition: `request` gains a producing intake process, the feature
typedef's framing link admits a request, discovery's `topic` input and
the initiative admit one, the decision brief's closed field set gains
related-to. The definitions fit one session; the example change
delivered and verified through the new lane may not. (architect,
2026-09-04)

Hypothesis, no observed use: "make a request" becomes a core-task entry
holding on every type — options: state the ask in the originator's
words; see the request's id; see its route (discovery, small lane,
declined) and reason. The conversational door is an assistant
interaction: the router says the route before acting, and the person
can correct it (`control-stays-with-the-person`). (designer,
2026-09-04)

## Decomposition

None: no Bounded Context is touched. Every amended definition and the
example change sit in the lead shop's tree; no contract exists on this
branch to rely on. Cross-context flow: none.

## Features

None yet.

## Document History

| Version | Date | Kind | Entry |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 2026-09-04 | update | Recorded `proposed` by the discovery conversation's frame step, on the authority's convergence — "Keep the hinge, one session, converge" (work item lead-1kp6m; session sess-2026-09-04-b). Positions reached in the conversation and recorded for the check: the request is the front-end record for every ask and the durable one, the work register holding work in motion only and pointing at it; the small lane is a feature with a size, framed by its request, not a new type; the lead-pm routes and records, rejection handled with the authority. |

Scenario 4 carries no exemption (per its history); if these are intended as the what, the outcome can be stated as "every ask is recorded on arrival and has a decided route" without naming who routes or the lane. If the authority reads a role assignment and a lane as outcome, this passes.

  section: Framing

  change: "a recorded, routed request" names the record type the mechanism will produce. If "request" is the defined term for an ask at the door, it is a what and passes; if it is the artifact Feasibility says will gain "a producing intake process", it is a form. No scenario names this tension, but a reader cannot tell whether the bet is one session for the definitions, with the verified result deferred, or one session for the verified result. Say which, in Appetite.
